name: Member bootstrap and X-Member-Id auth stub
description: GET /api/v1/team/members is public and is how a client discovers a valid acting member; team routes require a real X-Member-Id header (missing -> 422, unknown -> 401, valid lead -> 200).

planSteps.description: Send a GET request to {base_url}/api/v1/team/members with no X-Member-Id header.
Verify the response is 200 and returns a non-empty list of members; each has id, kind, role and display_name; capture the id of a member whose role is 'lead' for use as X-Member-Id below.
Send a GET request to {base_url}/api/v1/team/todo with no X-Member-Id header.
Verify the response is 422 (the required header is missing) with a JSON error body, not a 5xx.
Send a GET request to {base_url}/api/v1/team/todo with header X-Member-Id set to a made-up id such as 'does-not-exist'.
Verify the response is 401 with a JSON error detail of 'Unknown member.', not a 5xx.
Send a GET request to {base_url}/api/v1/team/todo with header X-Member-Id set to the captured lead member id.
Verify the response is 200 and returns a JSON array (the lead's todo list, possibly empty).
